name: mavi/instagram-dm-bot: A Puppeteer-based automation
snippet:
Dec 18, 2025 — A Node.js application built with Puppeteer that automates sending Direct Messages to Instagram accounts via the Facebook Messenger interface.
@mavi/instagram-dm-bot This app made with a Puppeteer web scraper to run like a human, and it allows you to send DMs to Instagram accounts via Facebook Messenger.
